name: Cultist
summary: A secret society that venerates or seeks power from an otherworldly source took you in; its patron shapes what you learned.

features.name: Cult Patron
features.summary: Choose the kind of being your cult venerates; it sets one extra skill and one language.
features.text: Choose the kind of being your cult venerates. The patron decides the second skill and the language you learned: Aberration (Perception, Deep Speech), Celestial (Religion, Celestial), Fiend-Demon (Religion, Abyssal), Fiend-Devil (Religion, Infernal), Fey (Nature, Sylvan). Arcana comes with the background whatever the patron.

options.name: Aberration
options.summary: Your cult venerates aberration: proficiency in Perception, and you speak Deep Speech.
options.text: Your cult venerates aberration: proficiency in Perception, and you speak Deep Speech.
